facts.value: I discovered the BA in Irish Dance through my dance teacher who had studied at UL.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: Three years before starting the course, my parents and I came from France to visit the campus.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: Despite it being too early to begin my studies, I was welcomed by the faculty and was impressed by the facilities.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: The variety of classes surprised me. I wasn’t expecting to have so many opportunities for self-development with ballet, yoga and even hip hop as well as my core Irish dance classes.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: One of the most exciting opportunities during my studies was working with Breandán de Gallaí’s youth company on a creative residency on an island off the coast of Donegal.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: I had the privilege of performing with Dr de Gallaí’s professional company, Ériu, at a special anniversary gala.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: My advice to incoming students would be to take the course seriously. You have to be mentally and physically prepared to do a programme like this.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: It is important to eat and sleep well, to take care of yourself and to practice.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance
